in_hebrew.name: אליזבת
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא השופט שלי, משמעות השם אליזבת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליזבת הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא השופט שלי'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'אל' שפירושו אלוהים, ו'יזבת' שפירושו שופט. השם אליזבת מוזכר בתנ'ך כהשם של אשתו של יהויקים מלך יהודה.

in_greek.name: Ελισάβετ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ελισάβετ προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό όνομα 'אליזבת' (Elisheva) και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής μου'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η Ελισάβετ ήταν η μητέρα του Ιωάννη του Βαπτιστή και η ξαδέλφη της Μαρίας, της μητέρας του Ιησού.

in_latin.name: Elizabeth
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elizabeth origine hebraicum est, quod significat 'Deus est iudex meus'. Nomen hoc ad nos per Graeciam et Latinam linguam devenit. In Ecclesia primitiva, Elizabeth erat nomen sanctae, matris Ioannis Baptistae.

in_english.name: Elixabeth
in_english.meaning: God is my judge or consecrated to God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Elixabeth originates from the Hebrew name 'אליזבת' (Elisheva), meaning 'God is my judge' or 'consecrated to God'. It was popularized through the Bible, specifically in the New Testament, where Elizabeth was the mother of John the Baptist and the cousin of Mary, the mother of Jesus. The name has been widely used in Christian tradition, symbolizing faith, devotion, and spiritual leadership.

biblical_reference.note: Elizabeth was the mother of John the Baptist and the cousin of Mary.

saint_reference.note: An American Catholic nun and founder of the Sisters of Charity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Elizabeth has been popular in various cultures throughout history, particularly in Western Europe and the United States. Its classic and elegant sound has resonated with many, and it has been the name of numerous notable figures, including several queens and religious leaders.
data.spiritual_significance: Elizabeth is a strong name with deep biblical roots. It carries the message that our lives are an oath to God, a covenant between us and Him. It is a reminder of our commitment to follow God and live according to His will, and the hope that our lives will be a reflection of His love and grace. ELizabeth is not just a beautiful and classic name, but a sacred reminder of the importance of our faith and our connection to God.
